home.flush: Flush label, outline circle off, filled circle on

tankCalibration.action: Menu > Water tank / set full > capture current distance > Save
tankCalibration.fullPoint: Software-defined valid ToF distance below 125 mm maps to 100%
tankCalibration.lowWarning: Existing distance threshold retained: above 125 mm maps to 9%, warning below 10%
tankCalibration.intermediateMapping: Linear from calibrated full point to 10% at 125 mm; differs from original stepped display

flushGuard.source: fresh hardware gross weight, independent of tare and scale display
flushGuard.homeStatus: Guard runs silently; blocked or stopped actions explain the reason
flushGuard.realMachine: No-tray raw offsets still require calibration. Do not copy the illustrative prototype calibration into firmware.

retained: five profiles and all stored settings
preinfusion, soak, ramp, transition, profiling and dose
limitations: No connection to or control of the machine
Browser localStorage only; Export settings is a trial artifact
Cleaning timing and graph curves are illustrative simulations
New tank calibration and expanded flush guard are prototype requirements, not deployed firmware
No HMI/TFT compiled, firmware flashed, or settings written to controller

profileMenu.nameTap: Select profile without opening editor; persist active index immediately
profileMenu.editButton: Open the chosen profile editor without changing active index
profileMenu.renameAndSave: Save edited profile fields without changing the selected profile
profileMenu.startup: Restore last explicitly selected profile, irrespective of last edited or renamed profile
profileMenu.persistence: Selection alone does not save unrelated pending settings edits
profileMenu.existingFirmwareIssue: src/lcd/nextion.cpp lcdFetchCurrentProfile assigns settings.activeProfile from the editor-selected profile. Future integration must use a separate editor index and persist explicit selection separately.

manualFlow.entry: Menu > Manual flow, separate from saved brew profiles
source: source/current-interface.json: bM page h0 slider range 0..130, mlPerSec display
manualFlow.brewSwitch: Starts and stops dispensing; screen and slider remain available while brewing
manualFlow.scaleFailure: Flow control and timer remain usable. No weight-based automatic stop in manual mode. No invented weight reading.
manualFlow.profileIsolation: Temporary manual target never writes profile values
manualFlow.exit: Auto returns to automatic shot view; Back/Home leave manual mode
manualFlow.scope: Simulated browser behavior; historical firmware logic and dimensions inspected locally
